d: At BKN301, we build fintech solutions that help banks, fintechs, and merchants to grow and innovate across emerging markets.
We are a financial technology group headquartered in London, with offices in Milan (Italy), Doha (Qatar), and San Marino, and our international presence keeps growing.

We work across many countries and markets, so our teams bring different perspectives, backgrounds, and expertise. That mix helps us innovate faster, respond to change, and deliver better solutions to our clients.
We move quickly, think internationally, and work as one team to turn ideas into fintech products that scale.
At BKN301 you join a fast-growing international fintech where technology and people develop side by side.
Your work will shape strategic growth initiatives, support our expansion into key markets, and contribute directly to the company's long-term success.
You'll arrive in Riyadh at an important moment. You'll help set up and grow our local presence, build strategic relationships, and support BKN301's long-term plans in the Kingdom.
We value what each person brings, leave room to experiment, and stay open to new ideas, because our results depend on the people behind them.
q: Solid compliance experience in financial services, fintech, or digital assets.
Working knowledge of crypto and digital asset activities and their compliance and financial crime risks.
Proven track record of building or substantially improving compliance frameworks and procedures.
Familiarity with the GCC regulatory environment.
Hands-on experience preventing and managing fraud, phishing, and scam attempts in a comparable regulated environment.
Professional proficiency in Arabic and English.
Soft Skills That Make a Difference
Sound independent judgement, especially when there's no precedent to follow.
Structured, pragmatic approach that turns complex rules into workable processes.
Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-changing environment.
Strong sense of ownership over outcomes and controls.
r: p
We're launching a new business focused on tokenized and fractionalized real-world assets, and we need someone to build its compliance foundations from day one.
p
You'll set up and oversee the compliance framework. You'll turn regulatory requirements into policies, procedures, and controls that work in practice.
p
This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can make independent calls and put effective controls in place while processes and regulation are still taking shape.
h
A few examples of your responsibilities
li

Design and maintain compliance policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, escalation, and the approval and sign-off of mint, burn, and transfer operations.
li
Review higher-risk customers and take KYC/KYT/EDD decisions within your delegated authority.
li
Set up procedures to identify, assess, and report suspicious activity in line with applicable requirements.
li
Assess the compliance impact of new products, transaction flows, and service providers before they go live.
li
Turn regulatory changes into clear operating instructions for the Operations and KYC/KYT/AML teams.
li
Work with management, legal advisers, and relevant authorities, and lead staff training and regulatory readiness.
li
Build controls that fit an initial manual set-up, then adapt them as systems and volumes grow.
x: The chance to build compliance for a new business and shape BKN301's presence in the Kingdom.
Room to grow and learn within an innovative group.
International culture built on trust and collaboration.

At BKN301, we believe the best ideas come from different perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer that values diverse backgrounds, cultures, and experiences, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

d: Join World Padel Academy – Muscat, Oman
World Padel Academy (WPA) is seeking an experienced Padel Coach to deliver professional coaching programmes for players of varying ages and abilities.
The successful candidate will support player development, maintain high coaching standards, and contribute to the growth of WPA’s academies and programmes.
q: Demonstrated experience coaching padel across a range of ages and ability levels.
Strong technical knowledge and the ability to deliver structured, engaging coaching sessions.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
Proficiency in Playtomic, Padelmates, or similar booking and scheduling platforms.
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, public holidays, and across WPA venues as required.
A recognised padel coaching certification is preferred. Candidates with a racket sports coaching background may also be considered.
If you are passionate about padel and committed to helping players reach their potential, we would welcome the opportunity to hear from you.
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV and take the next step in your coaching career with WPA.
r: li
Deliver individual, group, junior, and corporate coaching sessions in accordance with WPA standards.
li
Assess players’ abilities and develop structured sessions aligned with their objectives and development needs.
li
Support academies, camps, leagues, tournaments, and community events.
li
Establish strong client relationships to encourage continued participation and long-term player development.
li
Identify talented players and support their progression through WPA’s player pathway.
li
Coordinate with venue teams on court bookings, scheduling, client feedback, and operational requirements.
li
Promote coaching packages and programmes, and support promotional activities when required.
li
Ensure sessions are delivered safely, professionally, and punctually, with appropriate care of courts and equipment.
